nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Grade 6 Mathematics Term 1

nodes.title: Whole Numbers: Counting, Ordering, Comparing and Representing
nodes.description: Count forwards and backwards in whole numbers to at least 9-digit numbers. Order and compare 9-digit numbers. Recognise and represent prime numbers to at least 100.

nodes.title: Whole Numbers: Addition and Subtraction
nodes.description: Add and subtract whole numbers of at least 5 and 6 digits. Use a calculator to check results. Solve problems in context involving multiple operations.

nodes.title: Whole Numbers: Multiplication
nodes.description: Multiply at least 4-digit by 3-digit numbers. Determine prime factors of numbers to at least 100. Perform multiple operations on whole numbers. Solve problems in context.

nodes.title: Formal Assessment Task: Assignment
nodes.description: Formal Assessment Task — Assignment.

nodes.title: Whole Numbers: Division
nodes.description: Divide at least 4-digit by 3-digit numbers using long division. Perform multiple operations on whole numbers. Solve problems in context.

nodes.title: Revision
nodes.description: Revision of Term 1 content.

nodes.title: Test
nodes.description: Formal Assessment Task — Test.

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Grade 6 Mathematics Term 2

nodes.title: Formal Assessment Task: Investigation
nodes.description: Formal Assessment Task — Investigation.

nodes.title: Number Sentences
nodes.description: Write and solve number sentences by inspection, trial and improvement and backtracking. Solve problems using number sentences.

nodes.title: Numeric Patterns
nodes.description: Investigate and extend numeric patterns involving sequences not limited to a constant difference or ratio. Describe patterns using flow diagrams and tables.

nodes.title: Geometric Patterns
nodes.description: Investigate and extend geometric patterns in physical and diagram form. Represent patterns using tables and flow diagrams.

nodes.title: Common Fractions
nodes.description: Recognise and use equivalent forms including tenths, hundredths and percentages. Order and compare fractions. Perform operations with fractions.

nodes.title: Decimal Fractions
nodes.description: Recognise and use decimal fractions to at least two decimal places. Multiply and divide decimal fractions by 10 and 100. Solve problems in context.

nodes.title: Revision
nodes.description: Revision of Term 2 content.

nodes.title: Test
nodes.description: Formal Assessment Task — Test.

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Grade 6 Mathematics Term 3

nodes.title: Formal Assessment Task: Project
nodes.description: Formal Assessment Task — Project.

nodes.title: Length
nodes.description: Measure, estimate, record, compare and order length using decimal fractions to at least two decimal places. Convert between units of length.

nodes.title: Properties of 2D Shapes
nodes.description: Recognise, visualise and name 2D shapes including parallelograms and octagons. Describe, sort and compare 2D shapes. Identify and describe types of angles: acute, right, obtuse, straight, reflex and revolution. Use compasses for constructions.

nodes.title: Symmetry, Transformations and Enlargements
nodes.description: Recognise and draw lines of symmetry. Describe and perform enlargements and reductions of triangles and quadrilaterals by a given factor.

nodes.title: Properties of 3D Objects
nodes.description: Recognise, visualise and name 3D objects including tetrahedrons. Describe and compare 3D objects in terms of edges, vertices and faces. Build 3D objects from nets.

nodes.title: Area, Perimeter and Volume
nodes.description: Calculate perimeter and area of squares and rectangles using formulas. Calculate volume of rectangular prisms using the formula l×w×h. Calculate surface area of rectangular prisms.

nodes.title: Revision
nodes.description: Revision of Term 3 content.

nodes.title: Test
nodes.description: Formal Assessment Task — Test.

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Grade 6 Mathematics Term 4

nodes.title: Mass
nodes.description: Measure, estimate, record, compare and order mass using decimal forms to at least two decimal places. Convert between units of mass.

nodes.title: Time
nodes.description: Read and record time using analogue and digital instruments. Solve problems involving time zones. Know relationships between centuries, decades, years, weeks and days.

nodes.title: Capacity and Volume
nodes.description: Measure, estimate, record, compare and order capacity and volume using kilolitres and decimal forms to at least two decimal places. Convert between units.

nodes.title: Data Handling
nodes.description: Collect data using questionnaires. Organise and represent data using double bar graphs. Identify the mode and median of data sets. Critically read and interpret data.

nodes.title: Four Operations in Context
nodes.description: Solve problems in context involving all four operations with whole numbers and fractions. Perform multiple operations following the correct order of operations.

nodes.title: Revision
nodes.description: Revision of Term 4 content and year.

nodes.description: Formal Assessment Task — End-of-year Test.
